title: One-function church radio box
problem: Multi-function radios/CD players overwhelm users. Some families only need one trusted audio source (church service, AM station, hymn stream) with a single giant button.
solution: 3D-printed one-button audio box around ESP32 + amp/speaker or a pre-tuned simple radio module. Caregiver presets the only station/stream.
whyWidespread: Niche but emotionally important. Lower mass-market than TV/phone, still recurring.
targetUser: Faith-oriented families wanting continuity of Sunday service / familiar audio.
fitForGeorge: Excellent tinkerer + 3D print project. Hardware/firmware more than app ecosystem.

feasibility.notes: Internet-radio path is easy; true AM reception is messier. Start with preset stream.

market.profitHypothesis: Low BOM, charming product, but smaller TAM than TV/phone.

softwarePlan.summary: ESP32 firmware boots to one preset stream, single button = play/stop, optional rotary volume hidden under caregiver lid.

solved: Attractive low-cost BOM path identified via Amazon browser pricing
nextActions: Pick one local church stream style example for demo
If greenlit, Codex terra high firmware skeleton
notes: Great quick hardware win / portfolio piece; probably not the biggest business.
